name: XSTABLE Protocol
report: The vulnerability stems from an incorrect logic check in the _transfer function: when tokens are transferred to a supported pool, the transaction is classified as type 1 (buy), triggering _implementBuy and allowing the sender to receive rewards via skim(). This enables an attacker to transfer more XST tokens to the pair to get more XST tokens.
report_zh: 漏洞源自 _transfer 函数中的错误逻辑检查：当代币被转移到受支持的池子时，该交易被归类为类型 1（买入），从而触发 _implementBuy，并允许发送者通过 skim() 获得奖励。这使得攻击者能够将更多 XST 代币转移到交易对中，以获取更多 XST 代币。
